arg_types.WSTRING: Wide string (LPCWSTR) - allocate wchar_t buffer from logged string
arg_types.HANDLE: Windows handle - resolve via HandleMap before calling
arg_types.NULL_OR_PTR: Optional pointer (security attrs etc.) - pass as NULL
arg_types.DATA_IN: Input data buffer - allocate zeros of size_bytes or size_arg bytes
arg_types.DATA_OUT: Output data buffer - allocate size_bytes or size_arg bytes
arg_types.ADDR_PTR: Socket address pointer - resolve via PointerMap (from GetAddrInfoW)
arg_types.PTR_OUT: Pointer-to-pointer output - register result in PointerMap
arg_types.PROCESS_ID: Process ID (dwProcessId in OpenProcess etc.) - resolve via PidMap
arg_types.HANDLE_ARRAY: Pointer to HANDLE array (WaitForMultipleObjects etc.) - build from inline_handles via HandleMap; nullptr + [APPROX] if inline_handles absent
arg_types.SIZE_INOUT: In/out buffer size (LPDWORD) - alloc DWORD init to default_size; also alloc linked DATA_OUT at size_arg index to default_size; retry once on ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER
arg_types.ASTRING: ANSI string (LPCSTR) - convert wstring to char[] buffer (used for GetProcAddress function name etc.)
arg_types.REGISTRY_SUBKEY: Registry subkey path - if RegistrySandbox enabled: resolve preceding HANDLE arg via HandleMap, call Redirect(hKey,subkey) → override preceding HANDLE arg value with sandbox_hkey and use sandbox_subkey as buffer; else treat as WSTRING
arg_types.REGISTRY_SUBKEY_A: Registry subkey path (ANSI variant) - same sandbox redirect logic as REGISTRY_SUBKEY, but produces char[] via WideCharToMultiByte(CP_ACP) instead of wchar_t[] (used for RegOpenKeyExA / RegCreateKeyExA etc.)

return_types.SOCKET: Register return value in HandleMap (SOCKET type)
return_types.HMODULE: Register return value in HandleMap (module handle)
return_types.HINTERNET: Register return value in HandleMap (WinINet handle)
return_types.SC_HANDLE: Register return value in HandleMap (service handle)
return_types.HCRYPTPROV: Register return value in HandleMap (crypto provider)
return_types.HCRYPTHASH: Register return value in HandleMap (crypto hash)
return_types.PTR: Register return value in PointerMap (virtual address)
return_types.STATUS: LSTATUS / NTSTATUS (0 = success), no HandleMap action

out_handle.arg_idx: 0-based index of the output pointer argument
out_handle.key: Field name used in out_handles (matches log_format_spec.md)
